title: IT Project Manager (2–5 Yrs) – Software & Cloud
meta_description: Seeking IT Project Manager with 2–5 yrs exp. in software/cloud projects. Lead teams, manage timelines & budgets. PMP/Agile certs preferred.
clean_text:
Project Manager
Experience : 5 to 6 years
No of opening - 2
2 - 5 Years of IT project management experience, preferably in software development, infrastructure, or cloud projects.Proven track record of managing budgets, timelines, and cross-functional teams.
Responsibilities
Project Initiation: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders.
Planning & Scheduling: Create detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, budgets, and resource allocation. Identify dependencies, risks, and mitigation strategies.
Execution & Monitoring: Lead cross-functional teams (developers, QA, DevOps, business analysts, etc.). Monitor progress, track KPIs, and ensure adherence to project scope.
Stakeholder & Client Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, vendors, and internal teams. Ensure clear communication of project expectations, progress, and issues. Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve conflicts proactively.
Quality Assurance & Risk Management: Implement QA processes to ensure deliverables meet client and business standards.
Project Closure: Ensure all project deliverables are completed and approved. Facilitate smooth handover to operations/support teams. Obtain formal sign-off from stakeholders and clients.
Requirements
Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related field. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile (Scrum, SAFe), or similar certification preferred.
Proficiency in JIRA, MS Project, Trello, Asana, or similar tools.
Knowledge of DevOps, Cloud (AWS/Azure), and IT security principles.
Experience with Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, and Hybrid methodologies.
HR Department
At Sculptsoft, we’re always on the lookout for talented professionals to join our team. Submit your resume and take the first step toward an exciting career with us.
